**What are you trying to build?**
The experiment, not the API — what the subject sees and what is measured.

**What did you have to write yourself to do it?**
If you worked around it, the workaround is the most useful thing here: it
shows where the seam should have been.

**Which layer do you think it belongs in?**
(phase, scheduler, device, stimulus, analysis — a guess is fine.)
